required_assets: Kaggle Writeup with selected ARC-AGI-3 track
optional_assets: Public project link or public PDF
notes: The Paper Track is a hackathon and permits exactly one submitted Writeup per team.
A draft or unsubmitted Writeup is not eligible.
The ARC Prize summary lists November 8, but the binding Kaggle overview and metadata list November 9 at 23:59 UTC. Use November 8 as the operational safety deadline.
The linked ARC-AGI-3 notebook must be public and the Paper Track team must exactly match the code-track team.
